market_note: Stablecoin market cap holds near $301B as Circle backs stricter GENIUS Act rules while Tether's El Salvador base keeps USDT outside the U.S. audit framework.

stablecoin_items.headline: Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HKDAP set to launch
stablecoin_items.summary: A Standard Chartered-led venture's HKD-pegged stablecoin could begin trading as early as today, one of the first HKD stablecoins issued under Hong Kong's new regulatory framework.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether's USAT goes live on Celo
stablecoin_items.summary: Tether deployed its GENIUS Act-aligned USAT stablecoin on Celo with native mint, burn, and gas support, its second network beyond Ethereum mainnet.

stablecoin_items.headline: Revolut users rush out of USDT before delisting
stablecoin_items.summary: USDT withdrawals hit $855M in a week and $2B in a month on Revolut as clients exit ahead of the platform's USDT delisting on August 31.

stablecoin_items.headline: Circle backs tougher stablecoin oversight under GENIUS Act
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle told the OCC it supports requiring only licensed entities to issue stablecoins, sharpening the compliance contrast with offshore issuer Tether.

hack_items.headline: AFX-powered bridge exploit drains $24M on Arbitrum
hack_items.summary: Attackers compromised private keys from five validators to hit quorum and drain roughly $24.15M in USDC, converting it to ETH in a single wallet.

hack_items.headline: H1 2026 sets record for crypto hacks: $1.1B stolen
hack_items.summary: Blockaid's first-half report counted 212 verified exploits across protocols, wallets, and infrastructure, the worst half-year on record despite fewer, more surgical attacks.

hack_items.headline: Verus Ethereum Bridge hacked a second time
hack_items.summary: An attacker siphoned about $7.54M from the Verus Ethereum Bridge on July 23, the bridge's second breach this year.

hack_items.headline: North Korea tied to npm wallet-drainer supply-chain attack
hack_items.summary: Amazon linked last year's hijack of npm packages debug and chalk to North Korean actors; a phished maintainer let a wallet-draining script reach 18+ packages with 2B+ weekly downloads.
